name: OpenViking Context Database for AI Agents
idSeed: OpenViking v0.5 Context Database for AI Agents
description: One self-hosted store for agent memory, knowledge and skills, with an API.

OpenViking.startCommand: /bin/sh -c 'set -eu; conf="${OPENVIKING_CONFIG_FILE:-/app/.openviking/ov.conf}"; mode="${OPENVIKING_CONF_MODE:-seed}"; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$conf")"; case "$mode" in seed) if [ -s "$conf" ]; then write=0; else write=1; fi;; overwrite) write=1; if [ -s "$conf" ]; then cp -p "$conf" "$conf.previous"; fi;; *) echo "[railway] OPENVIKING_CONF_MODE must be seed or overwrite, got: $mode" >&2; exit 2;; esac; if [ "$write" = 1 ]; then if [ -z "${OPENVIKING_CONF_CONTENT:-}" ]; then echo "[railway] OPENVIKING_CONF_CONTENT is empty, cannot create $conf" >&2; exit 2; fi; (umask 077; printf "%s\n" "$OPENVIKING_CONF_CONTENT" > "$conf.tmp"); mv -f "$conf.tmp" "$conf"; echo "[railway] wrote $conf from OPENVIKING_CONF_CONTENT ($mode mode)"; else echo "[railway] keeping existing $conf (seed mode: OPENVIKING_CONF_CONTENT only seeds a new volume)"; fi; set -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port "${PORT:-1933}"; case "${OPENVIKING_WITH_BOT:-1}" in 1|true|TRUE|yes|on) set -- "$@" --with-bot --disable-bot-logging;; 0|false|FALSE|no|off) ;; *) echo "[railway] OPENVIKING_WITH_BOT must be 1 or 0" >&2; exit 2;; esac; echo "[railway] starting openviking-server $*"; exec openviking-server "$@"'

PORT.description: Port the server listens on; Railway routes the domain and the healthcheck here.

OPENVIKING_ROOT_API_KEY.description: Root (admin) key, generated at deploy. Creates accounts and user keys; it cannot read tenant data.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: REQUIRED. API key for an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, used for embeddings and the LLM by default.

OPENAI_API_BASE.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL shared by embeddings and LLM (e.g. https://openrouter.ai/api/v1).

OV_VLM_PROVIDER.description: LLM provider for summaries and memory extraction: openai, volcengine, litellm, kimi, glm, ...

OV_VLM_MODEL.description: LLM model id (upstream's OpenAI preset). A smaller model lowers ingestion cost.

OV_VLM_API_KEY.description: LLM key. Defaults to OPENAI_API_KEY; override to use a different provider.

OV_VLM_API_BASE.description: LLM base URL. Defaults to OPENAI_API_BASE.

OV_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER.description: Embedding provider: openai, azure, volcengine, jina, voyage, gemini, dashscope, cohere, ...

OV_EMBEDDING_MODEL.description: Embedding model id. Fix it before adding data: a new model needs a reindex.

OV_EMBEDDING_DIMENSION.description: Vector size of the embedding model (1536 for text-embedding-3-small). Must match the model.

OV_EMBEDDING_API_BASE.description: Embedding base URL. Defaults to OPENAI_API_BASE.

OV_OAUTH_ENABLED.description: OAuth 2.1 for MCP clients such as Claude.ai and ChatGPT; consent still needs a user API key.

OV_LOG_LEVEL.description: Server log level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR.

OPENVIKING_PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: Public HTTPS URL used for OAuth metadata and MCP upload/download links.

OPENVIKING_WITH_BOT.description: 1 runs the built-in VikingBot (Studio chat) next to the API, shell exec off; 0 runs the API only.

OPENVIKING_CONF_MODE.description: seed writes ov.conf only on a new volume; overwrite rewrites it from OPENVIKING_CONF_CONTENT each start.

OPENVIKING_CONF_CONTENT.description: Seed ov.conf. ${VAR} placeholders are filled from this service's variables at every start.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Time to finish requests and close the embedded vector store before a redeploy stops it.
